raw_text: विश्वास न्यूज़ की जाँच: वायरल तस्वीरें जिनमें विपक्षी नेताओं को दुबई में विदेशी एजेंटों से मिलते दिखाया गया है, पूरी तरह AI से बनाई गई हैं। Vishvas News investigation: Viral photos showing opposition leaders meeting foreign agents in Dubai are entirely AI-generated. The images were created using PolitiMeme app which is freely available on app stores. Multiple digital forensic indicators confirm artificial generation including lighting inconsistencies, background anomalies, and the app's partial watermark.
clean_text: Vishvas News confirms Dubai meeting photos are AI-generated using freely available PolitiMeme app. Digital forensic indicators include lighting inconsistencies, background anomalies, and partial watermark. Hindi and English bilingual report.
